cells.gaps: No source found says NSDS II has been adopted: FAO's May 2026 reference to aligning with it does not say so, and the Master Plan 2021-2025 has run out. No review of progress in the last three years has been found.
cells.note: The National Bureau of Statistics said in September 2025 that NSDS II was being developed, and the Master Plan before it ran to 2025. No source states NSDS II adopted, so the cell stands at stage 2, not 3.
